page_title: ChemCrow: Augmenting large-language models with chemistry tools

summary.name: ChemCrow
summary.one_liner: ChemCrow is an LLM-based chemistry agent that combines a large language model with 18 expert-designed chemistry tools to plan and carry out tasks in organic synthesis, drug discovery, and materials design.
use_cases: planning organic syntheses with an AI agent
accessing computational chemistry tools without steep learning curves
summary.what_it_does: The page is the arXiv abstract for the ChemCrow paper (first submitted April 2023, latest revision October 2023). It describes an LLM chemistry agent that integrates 18 expert-designed chemistry tools to augment LLM performance on chemistry problems. The authors report that the agent autonomously planned and executed the syntheses of an insect repellent and three organocatalysts, and guided the discovery of a novel chromophore. The evaluation combines LLM-based and expert assessments. The abstract also notes that GPT-4 as an evaluator could not distinguish clearly wrong GPT-4 completions from ChemCrow's performance.
notable: Integrates 18 expert-designed chemistry tools with an LLM agent
Reported autonomous synthesis of an insect repellent and three organocatalysts
Guided discovery of a novel chromophore
Evaluation includes GPT-4-as-evaluator findings alongside expert assessment
caveats: The page is an abstract only; no software release, license, or installation details are given
The abstract notes GPT-4 as an evaluator could not reliably distinguish clearly wrong completions from ChemCrow's output
